en.sayed-ali-raza: I fear about you lest you fall into ignorance (that prevailed before the appearance of the Prophet).
In the past there were certain matters in which you were deflected, and in my view you were not worthy of admiration;
but if your previous position could be returned to you then you would become virtuous.
but if I were to speak I would (only) say may Allāh forgive your past actions.
